text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'The synthetic product is each hour's measured output plus random noise, so it carries part of the answer by construction. It exists only to show that a gain of this size is detectable. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Six solar farms in Lincolnshire, December 2022 to September 2026. Three wind farms in Lincolnshire, August 2024 to September 2026. Planned: a comparison written into the study plan after the first science review and before the re-run that measured it. Every other row is exploratory.'
